generation.explanation: The sine graph is wavy because sine tracks the height of a point moving around a circle at constant speed. As the point goes around, its height rises to 1, falls through 0 to -1, and comes back up. That repeating up-and-down motion, plotted against the angle, makes the wave. Drag the slider to move the point around the circle and watch its height trace the curve.
